grade: Crianças pequenas (4 anos a 5 anos e 11 meses)
subject: Escuta, Fala, Pensamento e Imaginação
description_pt: Inventar brincadeiras cantadas, poemas e canções, criando rimas, aliterações e ritmos.

components.description_pt: Inventar jogos de cantiga ou canções com padrões rítmicos
components.description_en: Invent singing games or songs with rhythmic patterns

components.description_pt: Criar rimas e aliterações em poemas ou canções auto-inventadas
components.description_en: Create rhymes and alliterations in self-invented poems or songs
components.cc_component_description: Identify structural elements of poems such as verse, rhythm, and meter

components.description_pt: Produzir padrões rítmicos através de brincadeiras com linguagem oral inventada
components.description_en: Produce rhythmic patterns through invented oral language play
components.cc_component_description: Recognize and produce rhyming words in spoken language

cc_matches.description: Explain major differences between poems, drama, and prose, and refer to the structural elements of poems (e.g., verse, rhythm, meter) and drama (e.g., casts of characters, settings, descriptions, dialogue, stage directions) when writing or speaking about a text.
Demonstrate understanding of spoken words, syllables, and sounds (phonemes).
